invariants.rationale: The method uses map for operations such as resolveTemplateObject and loadObject, so it should be non-null.
parentLayers.add(layer) is called, so parentLayers should not be null.
element.getString(...) and other methods are invoked on element, so it should be non-null.
tmjFile is passed to resolveTemplateObject, so it should not be null.
The main body is only executed if element.getString("type", "") equals "objectgroup"; otherwise, method is a no-op.
